<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>well</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwell ˈup</b></td><td class="c3">液体溢出；涌出<br><span class="en">if a liquid wells up, it rises to the surface and starts to flow</span></td><td class="c4">Tears <b>welled up</b> in his eyes.<br>他热泪盈眶。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwell ˈup</b></td><td class="c3">情感迸发；勃发；涌上心头<br><span class="en">(in/inside sb) if an emotion wells up, you start to feel it very strongly</span></td><td class="c4">She felt anger <b>welling up</b> inside her.<br>她感到怒火。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>whack</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwhack sb ˈout <span class="tag">(informal, especially AmE)</span></b></td><td class="c3">谋杀；杀掉<br><span class="en">to murder sb</span></td><td class="c4">They never found out who <b>whacked out</b> that old tramp.<br>他们一直没查出是谁杀死了那个老流浪汉。ˌ。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwhack sb ˈout <span class="tag">(informal, especially AmE)</span></b></td><td class="c3">十分疲劳；精疲力竭</td><td class="c4">I was <b>whacked out</b> by the time I reached home.<br>我到家时累坏了。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>whale</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwhale at/into/on sb <span class="tag">(AmE, informal)</span></b></td><td class="c3">不断猛打；接连狠揍<br><span class="en">to attack sb by hitting them repeatedly with force</span></td><td class="c4">We came in the room and found him <b>whaling on</b> his brother.<br>我们进了屋发现他在狠揍他弟弟。<br>I was angry, I simply <b>whaled into</b> him.<br>我气愤极了，就那么猛揍了他一通。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wink</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwink at sth</b></td><td class="c3">尤指对环事佯装没看见；对…视而不见<br><span class="en">to pretend that you have not noticed sth, especially sth bad or illegal</span></td><td class="c4">The authorities have chosen to <b>wink at</b> the illegal trade.<br>当局决定对这种非法贸易睁一只眼闭一只眼。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>winkle</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwinkle sb/sth ˈout<br>ˌwinkle sb/sth ˈout of sth <span class="tag">(BrE)</span></b></td><td class="c3">从…挖出；掏出；逐出；逼使(从…)离开<br><span class="en">to get sb/sth out of somewhere slowly and with difficulty</span></td><td class="c4">The bird uses its beak to <b>winkle insects out</b> of tree trunks.<br>这种鸟用尖嚎从树干里啄出虫子。<br>The terrorusts have been <b>winkled out</b> of their hiding place.<br>恐怖分子被迫从藏身地跑了出来。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wipe</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwipe sth ˈdown</b></td><td class="c3">揩擦；擦拭(物体表面)<br><span class="en">to clean a surface with a cloth</span></td><td class="c4">Tom had carefully <b>wiped</b> his fingerprints off the glass.<br>汤姆小心翼翼地擦去了自己留在玻璃杯上的指纹。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwipe sth ˈdown</b></td><td class="c3">降低(尤指股票)的价值<br><span class="en">to reduce the value of sth, especially shares</span></td><td class="c4">Over £5 billion was <b>wiped</b> off share values worldwide today.<br>今天全球股票价格下挫了 50 多亿英镑。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwipe sth ˈdown</b></td><td class="c3">消除；除掉<br><span class="en">to get rid of sth</span></td><td class="c4"><b>Wipe</b> that smile off your face!<br>别笑了。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wire</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwire sb/sth ˈup (to sth)</b></td><td class="c3">用导线将…连接到(电气设备)<br><span class="en">to connect sb/sth to a piece of electrical equipment by using electrical wires</span></td><td class="c4">You will be <b>wired up</b> to a machine which will record your heartbeat.<br>你身上会连接电线，与记录心搏的仪器连通。<br>The police suggested I should be <b>wired up</b> (= to record the conversation) before I met the dealer.<br>警察建议我去见毒贩前应该接好录音设备。<br>The band's instruments were all <b>wired up</b> for sound.<br>乐队的乐器都接通了电源以增加音响效果。<br>The microphone hadn't been <b>wired up</b> properly.<br>话筒没接好。语态。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wise</b></td><td class="c2"><b>wise ˈup (to sth) <span class="tag">(informal, especially AmE)</span></b></td><td class="c3">意识到；觉察；发觉(令人不快的实情)<br><span class="en">to become aware of the unpleasant truth about a situation</span></td><td class="c4">Employees should <b>wise up</b> about how the industry works.<br>雇员应当对本行业如何运作有所了解。<br>You need to <b>wise up</b> to the fact that he's never coming back.<br>你得明白他永远不会回来了。<br><b>Wise up</b>! Try and see her for what she really is.<br>清醒点！看清她到底是个什么样的人。<br>You need to <b>wise up</b> to how serious this situation is.<br>你必须意识到局势的严重性。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wish</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwish sb/sth aˈway</b></td><td class="c3">从心里竭力摆脱；希望(某事物)消失；希望(某人)走开<br><span class="en">to try to get rid of sth by wishing it did not exist; to wish that sb was somewhere else</span></td><td class="c4">These complications can't just be <b>wished away</b>, you know.<br>你知道，这些麻烦事儿并不是想让它们消失就能消失的。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wither</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwither aˈway</b></td><td class="c3">尤指消亡前萎缩；变弱<br><span class="en">to become less or weaker, especially before disappearing completely</span></td><td class="c4">All our hopes just <b>withered away</b>.<br>我们的一切希望就这样渐渐破灭了。<br>They predicted that the bad schools would <b>wither away</b>.<br>他们预言差学校将逐步消失。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wolf</b></td><td class="c2"><b>wolf sth ˈdown <span class="tag">(informal)</span></b></td><td class="c3">快速大吃；狼吞虎咽地吃<br><span class="en">to eat sth very quickly, especially in large quantities</span></td><td class="c4">He <b>wolfed down</b> his breakfast and rushed out of the house.<br>他狼吞虎咽地吃了早餐，然后就匆匆出了门。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wonder</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwonder at sth</b></td><td class="c3">对…感到诧异；对…觉得惊讶<br><span class="en">to be very surprised by sth</span></td><td class="c4">He <b>wondered at</b> her beauty.<br>他对她的美貌赞叹不已。<br>She <b>wondered at</b> her own stupidity.<br>她没想到自己会这么笨。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>work</b></td><td class="c2"><b>work aˈgainst sb/sth</b></td><td class="c3">妨碍；阻碍某人做成；某事；对…造成不便<br><span class="en">if sth works against sb/sth, it has the effect of making it harder for sb to do or achieve sth</span></td><td class="c4">The engineering career structure <b>works against</b> women.<br>工程行业的职业结构不利于女性。<br>The new policy has <b>worked against</b> the interests of farmers.<br>新政策损害了农民的利益。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork aˈround sth (BrE also ˌwork ˈround sth)</b></td><td class="c3">绕开；规避造成妨碍的；状况；规则等；绕道走<br><span class="en">to find a way of doing what you want to in spite of situations, rules, etc. that could prevent you doing it</span></td><td class="c4">He urged the two sides to <b>work around</b> their disputes and reach an agreement.<br>他敦促双方求同存异，达成协议。<br>My uncle couldn't read but he'd found ways to <b>work around</b> it because he was too embarrassed to tell anyone.<br>我叔叔不识字，但他设法回避这一点，因为他羞于让人知道。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwork at sth<br>ˈwork at doing sth</b></td><td class="c3">努力；致力于<br><span class="en">to make great efforts to achieve sth or do sth well</span></td><td class="c4">She <b>worked hard at</b> her French and Passed the exam.<br>她刻苦学习法语，通过了考试。<br>Youve got to <b>work at</b> losing weight.<br>你必须花力气减肥。<br>Marriage has to be <b>worked at</b>.<br>婚姻需要悉心维系。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork aˈway (at sth) often</b></td><td class="c3">常用于进行时<br><span class="en">used in the progressive tenses</span></td><td class="c4">Ruth spends hours in the library, <b>working</b> <b>away</b> at Japanese.<br>鲁思在图书馆一呆就是好几个小时，苦学日语。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork sth ˈin<br>ˌwork sth ˈinto sth</b></td><td class="c3">掺入；将…搅拌进<br><span class="en">to one substance to another and mix them together</span></td><td class="c4"><b>Work the butter in</b> your fingers.<br>用手指把黄油掺进去。<br>Use plenty of polish and <b>work it well into</b> the wood.<br>涂上足量的光蜡并使它充分渗入木料。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork yourself ˈinto sth</b></td><td class="c3">变得十分气愤或非常激动<br><span class="en">to become very angry, excited, etc.</span></td><td class="c4">He was <b>working himself into</b> a rage.<br>他开始暴跳如雷。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwork off sth</b></td><td class="c3">机器；电气设备等<br><span class="en">of a machine, a piece of electrical equipment, etc.</span></td><td class="c4">The lighter <b>works off</b> the car battery.<br>点火器利用车载蓄电池打火。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork sth ˈoff</b></td><td class="c3">通过消耗体力宣泄；消除<br><span class="en">to get rid of sth by physical effort</span></td><td class="c4">He went for a run to <b>work off</b> some calories.<br>他去跑步以消耗部分热量。<br>By the time she had finished cleaning, she had <b>worked off</b> her anger.<br>她打扫完卫生之后气就消了。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork sth ˈoff</b></td><td class="c3">挣钱还清(债务)<br><span class="en">to earn money to pay off a debt</span></td><td class="c4">They <b>worked off</b> their huge bank loan over five years.<br>他们工作了五年多才还清了那一大笔银行贷款。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork sth ˈoff</b></td><td class="c3">服从；接受(处罚等)<br><span class="en">if you work off a punishment, etc., you do what you have been told to do because you have done sth wrong or committed a crime</span></td><td class="c4">Keane has started to <b>work off</b> his eight-match suspension.<br>基恩开始接受停赛八场的处罚。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>f<br>work ˈout</b></td><td class="c3">进展；(尤指)成功地发展<br><span class="en">to happen or develop in a particular way, especially a successful way</span></td><td class="c4">Their marriage didn't <b>work out</b> (= was not successful).<br>他们的婚姻不美满。<br>It is all <b>working out</b> very well.<br>一切都进展得很顺利。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>f<br>work ˈout</b></td><td class="c3">计算；算出<br><span class="en">(at sth) if sth works out at sth, you calculate that it will be a particular amount</span></td><td class="c4">The rent <b>works out</b> at £50 a week each.<br>租金算下来是每人每周 50英镑。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈworkout n</b></td><td class="c3">锻炼<br><span class="en">a period of physical exercise</span></td><td class="c4">I did a two-hour <b>workout</b> in the gym.<br>我在健身房锻炼了两个小时。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork sb ˈout <span class="tag">(especially BrE)</span></b></td><td class="c3">了解；理解；弄懂(某人的性格)<br><span class="en">to understand sb's character</span></td><td class="c4">Can you <b>work out</b> the answer to number 2?<br>你能算出第 2 题的答案吗。<br>I <b>worked out</b> that we owe him £30.<br>我计算了一下，我们欠他30英镑。<br>Let me pay for now and we'll <b>work it out</b> later.<br>由我先付吧，我们以后再算清楚。<br>We <b>worked out</b> that we were second cousins.<br>我们搞清楚了我们原来是远房堂兄弟。<br>Can you <b>work out</b> what's going on?<br>你能弄明白目前的情况吗。<br>The game was fairly simple once wed <b>worked out</b> the rules.<br>我们搞清楚规则，这个游戏就很简单了。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork itself ˈout</b></td><td class="c3">问题逐步自行解决；逐渐自动化解<br><span class="en">if a problem works itself out, it gradually stops being a problem without anyone having to do anything</span></td><td class="c4">Did YOu think everything would just <b>work itself out</b>?<br>你是不是以为所有事情都会自动了结。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork sb ˈover</b></td><td class="c3">拷打；逼供<br><span class="en">to attack sb physically and injure them, either as a punishment or to get information from them</span></td><td class="c4">They sent the boys round to <b>work him over</b>.<br>他们派出了几个小兄弟去拷问他。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork ˈthrough</b></td><td class="c3">一段时间内连续工作；不停干活<br><span class="en">to work without stopping for a particular period of time</span></td><td class="c4">At harvest time we <b>work through</b> until it gets dark.<br>在收获季节，我们一直干到天黑。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork ˈthrough<br>ˌwork ˈthrough sth</b></td><td class="c3">开始影响；对…发挥作用<br><span class="en">to start to have an effect somewhere</span></td><td class="c4">These pressures have <b>worked through</b> to the staff.<br>这些压力影响到了员工。<br>The full effects of the change will take time to <b>work through</b> the system.<br>这项改革对整个体系产生全面影响尚需时日。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork ˈthrough<br>ˌwork ˈthrough sth</b></td><td class="c3">逐渐移动到；慢慢过波到<br><span class="en">to move or pass through sth gradually until you reach a particular point</span></td><td class="c4">I started at page one and slowly <b>worked my way through</b> to the end.<br>我从第一页慢慢读到结尾。<br>You shouldn't try to <b>work through</b> the course too fast.<br>你不该过快地完成这门课程。<br>Allow time for the drug to <b>work through</b> your body.<br>药效要过一段时间才会扩展到你全身。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwork to sth</b></td><td class="c3">遵照计划；根据…行事<br><span class="en">to follow a plan, etc.</span></td><td class="c4">We're <b>working to</b> a very right schedule.<br>我们的日程安排很满。<br>They have to <b>work to</b> a budget.<br>他们必须按照预算。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork toˈwards sth (also,work toˈward sth especially AmE)</b></td><td class="c3">努力达到；设法完成(目标)<br><span class="en">to try to reach or achieve goal</span></td><td class="c4">The two groups are <b>working towards</b> the same end.<br>这两个组正向同一目标迈进。<br>Jo' <b>working towards</b> obtaining a Master's degree.<br>乔正为获得硕士学位而努力。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork sth ˈup</b></td><td class="c3">逐步发展；逐渐增加(到足量)<br><span class="en">to gradually develop or increase sth until you have enough</span></td><td class="c4">We jogged up the hill to <b>work up</b> an appetite.<br>我们为增加食欲慢跑上山。<br>I can't <b>work up</b> much enthusiasm for this subject.<br>我对这个话题提不起多大热情。<br>She soon <b>worked up</b> a sweat.<br>她不一会儿就满身大汗了。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork sth ˈup</b></td><td class="c3">努力使改善；精心使完成<br><span class="en">(into sth) to spend time and effort on a piece of work in order to improve or complete it</span></td><td class="c4">The idea needs a Lot of <b>working up</b>.<br>这个创意需要下一番工夫加以完善。<br>You could <b>work up</b> this idea into a story.<br>你可以用这个构思创作出一个故事。<br>Some of the sketches were <b>worked up</b> into paintings.<br>有些速写加工成了油画。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwork ˈup to sth</b></td><td class="c3">逐步发展到；逐渐达到更高或更深的；程度<br><span class="en">to gradually prepare for and move towards sth that is more exciting or extreme</span></td><td class="c4">He started slowly and <b>worked up to</b> running ten miles a day.<br>他开始时慢跑，后来逐渐发展到一天跑十英里。<br>The tension <b>works up to</b> a climax towards the end of the film.<br>电影快结束时，紧张气氛达到了高潮。2。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>worm</b></td><td class="c2"><b>worm your way/yourself ˈinto sth <span class="tag">(informal disapproving)</span></b></td><td class="c3">逐渐贏得欢心；渐渐骗取信任(以获利)<br><span class="en">to gradually make sb like or trust you, especially in order to gain an advantage for yourself</span></td><td class="c4">Somehow he managed to <b>worm</b> his <b>way</b> <b>into</b> her confidence.<br>他不知用什么手段设法骗取了她的信任。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌworm sth ˈout of sb <span class="tag">(informal)</span></b></td><td class="c3">慢慢地从某人处套出话来；巧妙地套问出<br><span class="en">to manage to obtain information from sb, often by asking them questions in a clever way for a long period of time</span></td><td class="c4">It took me days to <b>worm the truth out of</b> my daughter.<br>我用了好几天时间才从女儿口中探听出真相。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wrap</b></td><td class="c2"><b>wrap ˈup<br>ˌwrap it ˈup <span class="tag">(slang)</span></b></td><td class="c3">粗鲁；的说法住口；闭嘴；安静点<br><span class="en">used to tell sb rudely to stop talking and be quiet</span></td><td class="c4">Oh <b>wrap up</b> and let somebody else say something!<br>喂，闭上嘴让别人说两句吧。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>wrap yourself ˈup (in sth)</b></td><td class="c3">使穿得暖和<br><span class="en">to put warn clothes, etc. on yourself/sb</span></td><td class="c4"><b>Wrap up</b> warm-it's really cold outside.<br>穿暖和一外面非常冷。<br>I <b>wrapped the twins up</b> before letting them go out.<br>我给这对双胞胎穿暖和了才让他们出去。<br>We were all well <b>wrapped up</b> against the weather.<br>我们都穿得厚厚的才能抵御寒冷天气。<br>I <b>wrapped myself up</b> against the cold.<br>我穿上了厚衣服御寒。<br>It took all the evening to <b>wrap up</b> the kids' presents.<br>为孩子们包圣诞礼物用了整整一晚上。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>wrap yourself ˈup (in sth)</b></td><td class="c3">圆满完成；顺利结束<br><span class="en">to complete sth in an acceptable way</span></td><td class="c4">The discussions should be <b>wrapped up</b> by Friday.<br>讨论到星期五应可圆满结束。<br>Well, I think that just about <b>wraps it up</b> for today.<br>好了，我想这差不多给今天画了个圆满的句号 ˈ。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wrench</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrench sth ˈoff<br>wrench sth ˈoff sth</b></td><td class="c3">从…上猛扭下；用力柠掉<br><span class="en">to remove sth from sth by force with a strong twisting movement</span></td><td class="c4">The tug of the rope nearly <b>wrenched</b> my arm of.<br>绳子差点把我的胳膊拽脱白。<br>He <b>wrenched the picture off</b> the wall and threw it to the ground.<br>他从墙上一把撕下那张画扔到地上。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wrest</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwrest sth from sb/sth <span class="tag">(formal)</span></b></td><td class="c3">从…攫取；抢夺(权力等)<br><span class="en">to take sth such as power or control from sb/sth with great effort</span></td><td class="c4">The rebels tried to <b>wrest</b> control of the town from government forces.<br>反叛者企图从政府军手中夺取这座小镇的控制权。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwrest sth from sb/sth <span class="tag">(formal)</span></b></td><td class="c3">从…强行取走；强夺<br><span class="en">to take sth from sb that they do not want to give, suddenly or violently</span></td><td class="c4">The officer managed to <b>wrest the gun from</b> his grasp.<br>警官最终把枪从他手中夺走了。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wrestle</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwrestle with sth</b></td><td class="c3">与…斗争；抵抗<br><span class="en">to struggle to deal with sth difficult</span></td><td class="c4">Farmers are <b>wrestling with</b> the problem of the wet weather.<br>农民们正在努力应对多雨天气。<br>He spent several more weeks <b>wrestling with</b> his conscience and then finally decided to resign.<br>他和自己的良心又搏斗了几个星期，最终决定辞职。<br>He <b>wrestled with</b> the reins as the horse galloped towards the cliff edge.<br>马向悬崖边飞奔，他拼命勒紧缰绳。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>wring</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwring sth ˈout</b></td><td class="c3">绞(布等)；拧出；绞出(水等液体)<br><span class="en">to remove water or other liquid from a cloth, etc. by twisting it tightly and squeezing it</span></td><td class="c4">Rinse the cloth and <b>wring it out</b> well.<br>把布冲洗一下并拧干。<br>My clothes got so wet I could <b>wring the water out</b>!<br>我的衣服湿得能柠出水来。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwring sth out of/from sb</b></td><td class="c3">从…费力弄到；从…施压逼出<br><span class="en">to obtain sth from sb with difficulty, especially by putting pressure on them</span></td><td class="c4">She eventually wrung an apology <b>out</b> of him.<br>她最终逼他道歉了。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>write</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrite ˈin (to sb/sth)</b></td><td class="c3">向某机构致函；致信(以表达意见或咨询问题)<br><span class="en">to write a letter to an organization to state an opinion or to ask a question</span></td><td class="c4"><b>Write in</b> to the programme and tell us your own opinion on this.<br>欢迎给节目组来信，告诉我们您对这个问题的见解。500。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrite sb/sth -'in <span class="tag">(AmE)</span></b></td><td class="c3">在选票上写；补写(非原定候选人姓名)<br><span class="en">to add an extra name to a list of candidates in an election so that you can vote for them</span></td><td class="c4">Workers were handing out sample ballots with their candidate's name <b>written</b> in.<br>工人们正在散发选票样本，上面加了他们选的非原定候选人的名字。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrite sb/sth ˈin<br>ˌwrite sb/sth ˈinto sth</b></td><td class="c3">把(人物或情节)加进；写进戏剧；电影；电视剧等中<br><span class="en">to add a character or a scene to a play, a film/movie, a regular series, etc.</span></td><td class="c4">Why did you <b>write the plane crash in</b>?<br>你为什么要加上坠机这一情节。<br>It was the first time a disabled child had been <b>written into</b> a soap.<br>这是电视肥皂剧中首次出现残障儿童这一角色。<br>He <b>wrote himself into</b> the history books by becoming the first player to win the championship five times.<br>他因首创五度夺冠的纪录而名载史册。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrite sth ˈin<br>ˌwrite sth ˈinto sth</b></td><td class="c3">把…写入文件；合同；协议等<br><span class="en">to include sth such as a special rule a condition in a document, a contract, an agreement, etc.</span></td><td class="c4">A get-out clause was <b>written into</b> the contract.<br>免责条款已写进合同。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>write ˈoff/aˈway (to sb) (for sth)</b></td><td class="c3">向某机构或公司致函；致信(索取资料等)；函索<br><span class="en">to write to an organization or a company, asking them to send you sth</span></td><td class="c4">She <b>wrote off</b> to an agency for advice.<br>她写信给代理行咨询。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>write sb/sth ˈoff (as sth)</b></td><td class="c3">认定…失败(或无关紧要)<br><span class="en">to consider that sb/sth is a failure or not important</span></td><td class="c4">I <b>wrote off</b> my symptoms as riredness.<br>我以为我的症状是疲劳所致。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrite sth ˈoff</b></td><td class="c3">注销；销记(负债)；认定…失败(或毫无价值等)<br><span class="en">(business) to cancel a debt; to recognize that sth is a failure, has no value, etc.</span></td><td class="c4">All outstanding Third World debts should now be <b>written off</b>.<br>第三世界所有未偿清的债务现在都应该勾销了。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrite sth ˈoff</b></td><td class="c3">把(车辆等)全毁；报废<br><span class="en">to damage a vehicle so badly that it is not worth spending money to repair it</span></td><td class="c4">That's the third car he's <b>written off</b> this year.<br>这是他今年报废的第三辆车。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwrite-off n</b></td><td class="c3">负债的注销；销记<br><span class="en">(business) an act of cancelling a debt and accepting that it will never be Paid</span></td><td class="c4">They escaped with minor injuries but the van was a <b>write-off</b>.<br>他们轻伤脱险，可是客货车却报废了。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrite sb/sth ˈout<br>ˌwrite sb/sth ˈout of sth</b></td><td class="c3">戏剧；电影；电视剧等中去掉；删除人物；情节等<br><span class="en">to remove a character, a scene, etc. from a play, a film/movie, a regular series, etc.</span></td><td class="c4">He got bored and asked to be <b>written out</b> of the series.<br>他厌烦了，于是要求删去他在电视剧中的戏份。<br>The Censor demanded that the scene be <b>written out</b>.<br>审查员要求删除这场戏。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrite sth ˈout</b></td><td class="c3">把…详细写清楚；全部；写出<br><span class="en">to write sth on paper clearly, including all the details</span></td><td class="c4">Use symbols and abbreviations instead of <b>writing things out</b> in full.<br>用符号和缩写，不用全写。<br>I <b>wrote out</b> the poem in my best handwriting.<br>我尽可能把这首诗写得工工整整。<br>I watched him <b>write out</b> a cheque for her.<br>我看着他开了一张支票给她。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrite sb ˈup <span class="tag">(AmE)</span></b></td><td class="c3">以书面形式正式地记录；控告(某人)<br><span class="en">to make an official report or complaint about sb in writing</span></td><td class="c4">He <b>wrote me up</b> for illegal parking.<br>他控告我违章停车。°。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌwrite sth ˈup</b></td><td class="c3">尤指借助笔记详细写出<br><span class="en">to write sth in a complete and final form, especially from notes that you have made</span></td><td class="c4">She <b>writes her lecture notes up</b> every night before going out.<br>她每晚外出前都把讲课笔记整理成。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈwrite-up n</b></td><td class="c3">报章；对音乐会；戏剧；书等的评述<br><span class="en">a review of a concert, a play, a book, etc. in a newspaper or magazine</span></td><td class="c4">The concert got a good <b>write-up</b> in all the papers.<br>音乐会博得报章的一致好评。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>yank</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈyank at sth</b></td><td class="c3">猛拉；猛拽<br><span class="en">to pull at sth hard and quickly</span></td><td class="c4">Someone <b>yanked at</b> my hair.<br>有人使劲扯我的头发。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>yank sth ˈoff<br>.yank sth ˈoff sth</b></td><td class="c3">从…猛地拉掉；猛力拽下<br><span class="en">to remove sth by pulling it quickly and hard</span></td><td class="c4">He <b>yanked off</b> his shoes.<br>他猛地扒下了鞋子。<br>She <b>yanked the lid off</b> the tin.<br>她用力拉掉了罐头的盖子。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>yearn</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈyearn for sb/sth <span class="tag">(literary)</span></b></td><td class="c3">切望；向往；思慕(尤指难以企及的人或事物)<br><span class="en">to want sb/sth very much, especially when this is difficult to get</span></td><td class="c4">Mira <b>yearned for</b> a child.<br>米拉渴望有个孩子。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>yell</b></td><td class="c2"><b>yell ˈout<br>yell sth ˈout</b></td><td class="c3">突然大喊；号叫<br><span class="en">to suddenly shout sth in a loud voice</span></td><td class="c4">She was <b>yelling out</b> in terror.<br>她吓得惊叫起来。<br>He <b>yelled out</b> the names of the winners.<br>他高声报出获胜者的名字。+。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>yield</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈyield to sth <span class="tag">(formal)</span></b></td><td class="c3">被…替代；为…取代<br><span class="en">to be replaced by sth</span></td><td class="c4">Barges <b>yielded to</b> road vehicles for transporting goods.<br>在货运方面，驳船让位于公路车辆。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈyield sth ˈup <span class="tag">(formal)</span></b></td><td class="c3">让出；放弃；让渡(自己看重的所有物)<br><span class="en">to allow sb else to take sth that you own and feel is very important for you</span></td><td class="c4">He swore he would never <b>yield up</b> the castle to the English.<br>他发誓永远不会把城堡交给英格兰人。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>ˈyield sth ˈup <span class="tag">(formal)</span></b></td><td class="c3">暴簬；揭露；展现<br><span class="en">to reveal sth that has been hidden</span></td><td class="c4">A thorough search of the site <b>yielded up</b> only a few ancient coins.<br>在这个遗址中进行了彻底搜索之后，只找到了几枚古钱币。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>zero</b></td><td class="c2"><b>zero ˈin on sb/sth</b></td><td class="c3">用武器瞄准；对准<br><span class="en">to aim weapons at sb/sth</span></td><td class="c4">They <b>zeroed in on</b> the target.<br>他们瞄准了目标。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>zero ˈin on sb/sth</b></td><td class="c3">全神贯注于；聚精会神于；专心致志于<br><span class="en">to fix all your attention on sb/sth</span></td><td class="c4">Wasting no time, she <b>zeroed in on</b> the main topic.<br>她直截了当地切入主题。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>zip</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌzip ˈthrough sth</b></td><td class="c3">很快地做；快速浏览<br><span class="en">to do, read, etc. sth very quickly</span></td><td class="c4">Could you <b>zip through</b> my report and check it's OK?<br>你能不能瞅一眼我的报告，看看是否可以。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 cont"></td><td class="c2"><b>zip ˈups<br>zip sb/sth ˈup</b></td><td class="c3">拉上(…的)拉链<br><span class="en">to be fastened with a zip; to fasten sth with a zip</span></td><td class="c4">The skirt <b>zips</b> up at the side.<br>这条裙子的拉链在侧面。<br>Will you <b>zip</b> me up (= my dress), please?<br>请帮我拉上拉链好吗。<br>I can't <b>zip</b> my jacket up!<br>我夹克衫的拉链拉不上！ˈ。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>zone</b></td><td class="c2"><b>ˌzone sth ˈoff (for sth)</b></td><td class="c3">某目的留出；划出(一片地)<br><span class="en">to keep an area of land to be used for a particular purpose</span></td><td class="c4">The city centre has been <b>zoned off</b> for pedestrians.<br>市中心已划为行人区。</td></tr>
<tr><td class="c1 newword"><b>zoom</b></td><td class="c2"><b>zoom ˈoff <span class="tag">(informal)</span></b></td><td class="c3">匆忙离去<br><span class="en">to hurry away</span></td><td class="c4">He jumped into his car and <b>zoomed off</b>.<br>他跳进车里开车跑了。</td></tr>
</table>
